name: @hadoku/server
description: Loopback tunnel server — serves the built @hadoku/ui SPA and the room/draft socket at hadoku.me/cardtable/, friend tier.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/index.ts src/pools/catalog-build-worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outdir=dist --entry-names=[name] --external:express --external:socket.io --external:@wolffm/rooms-protocol --external:@wolffm/rooms-server --external:@resvg/resvg-js && node ../../scripts/release/print-build-version.ts > dist/version.txt && tsx src/cli/warm-bridges.ts
